title: Morning Robotics Scan
report:
## FasTac tactile sensor

### The Breakthrough
FasTac is a curved vision‑based tactile fingertip that captures a single multispectral image to recover fine 3D geometry and three‑axis forces; its depth reconstruction error drops to 0.0415 mm (MAE) and force estimation error to ~2.7 % while the FPGA pipeline runs in 1.09 ms latency.

### The Caveats
The work does not compare FasTac against existing tactile sensors, leaving its performance advantage unverified.

## PAC-MAN humanoid dodgeball

### The Breakthrough
PAC‑MAN fuses control‑barrier‑function safety with perception‑aware RL using segmentation‑masked depth, achieving 95 % success on real‑world throws with a Unitree G1 robot deployed zero‑shot.

### The Caveats
The result is shown only on a single robot, fixed camera placement, and one lighting condition.

## FA‑RDP frequency‑adaptive manipulation

### The Breakthrough
FA‑RDP introduces a multi‑frequency visual‑force Transformer that switches from low‑frequency planning before contact to high‑frequency reactive control after contact, boosting success on three contact‑rich manipulation tasks.

### The Caveats
No baseline comparisons are provided, so relative improvement is unclear.

## X‑NavDP diffusion navigation

### The Breakthrough
X‑NavDP adds behavior‑perturbation exploration and Group Q‑score Reweighted Matching to a diffusion navigation policy, raising simulated success from 61.2 % to 84.28 % and real‑world hard‑case success from 10 % to 65 %.

### The Caveats
The paper never benchmarks against existing navigation baselines.

## Zoox robotaxi rides in Las Vegas

### The Breakthrough
Zoox secured a temporary NHTSA exemption allowing its toaster‑shaped shuttles without steering wheels or brakes to charge passengers in Las Vegas, permitting up to 2,500 vehicles per year for two years.

### The Caveats
No quantitative safety or performance data are provided.

## Gemini Robotics 2.0

### The Breakthrough
Gemini Robotics ER‑2 is a vision‑language model that ingests live video streams, achieving ~60 % frame‑completeness classification and claiming control of humanoid robots with complex hands via the Gemini Live API.

### The Caveats
The claim rests on a single classification score with no real‑world robot trials or safety metrics.

## Pomi voice agent for Rabbit R1

### The Breakthrough
Pomi runs fully on‑device on the Rabbit R1, offering offline wake‑word detection, local transcription overlay, and Hermes‑based dialogue management, plus OTA updates via Tailscale.

### The Caveats
Latency measurements and comparisons to existing assistants are absent.

## pixpick annotation toolkit

### The Breakthrough
pixpick provides a lightweight GUI to draw boxes, polygons, or lines on images/video and instantly outputs coordinates in formats for YOLO, SAM, etc., with JSON export for reproducible pipelines.

### The Caveats
No user study or robotics deployment evidence substantiates its claimed efficiency.

## Snakie MicroPython IDE

### The Breakthrough
Snakie integrates a Monaco editor with live pin‑out parsing to render board schematics and streams telemetry to built‑in oscilloscopes, multimeters, and plots, plus an AI ghost‑text assistant for MicroPython development.

### The Caveats
Performance and usability testing are missing, leaving productivity benefits unproven.

### Priority
FasTac delivers a compact, FPGA‑accelerated tactile fingertip with sub‑millimeter depth accuracy and sub‑2 ms latency, offering immediate value for anyone building high‑speed, precise manipulation systems.

### One action
Visit the FasTac project page to download the hardware design files and FPGA code, and evaluate its latency for your own gripper.
